end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya identified a remote-control car as cuboid and a ball as sphere.
They counted two flat ends for a cylinder but then changed the answer to cone.
When a cone was turned upside down, they called it a bowl; this was not corrected later.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying 3D shapes using familiar objects and their features, such as flat ends, a point, and a round surface. Aditya used the object’s appearance and explained their choices, including the remote-control car and cricket ball. The mix-up was that they thought turning a cone changed its name to bowl; this was still present at the end. At home, turn a cup, cone, or box around and ask Aditya to name the shape before and after turning it.
